usage: Usually refers to a customer in shops, restaurants, or service settings. It is a very common everyday noun.
Can be used on its own or in compounds like 訪客 or 顧客, but 客 is the shorter, more casual form in spoken Cantonese.
Often appears with words about serving people, such as 招呼客, 留住客, or 接客, depending on the business context.
Neutral and widely used in business talk. In Hong Kong speech, it is natural when talking about customers in retail, dining, and service work.
